name: Fire Circle
description: A communal hearth where the people gather. Boosts morale each season.

name: Drying Rack
description: Simple racks for air-drying fish and meat. Increases food preservation.

name: Smokehouse
description: A sealed structure for smoking meat and fish. Major food preservation.

name: Storage Pit
description: A cool underground cache. Extends stored food shelf life.

name: Watch Post
description: A raised platform giving hunters scouting advantage. Improves hunting yields.

name: Plank Lodge
description: A large cedar-plank dwelling for many families. Reduces winter mortality.
